# blockseed

> Rust implementation of a public daily seed derived from the first Bitcoin block of the UTC day.

## Documentation

- [Usage and assumptions](https://github.com/forgesworn/blockseed/blob/main/README.md): Verify headers locally, use the optional explorer fetcher or supply your own source.
- [Derivation rule](https://github.com/forgesworn/blockseed/blob/main/docs/RULE.md): Date boundaries, verification and known answers.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/blockseed): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
